teaching_clarity.rationale: The fluent launch request remains the concrete object of inquiry while hidden powers, coarse routing, desired outcome, authority, bounded defaults, an intent checksum, corrected assumptions, V1 and V2 contracts, affected-party gates, and downstream invariants successively answer what a request must become before action.

composition.rationale: All 81 start-middle-end delivery samples at 1920 by 1080 preserve a legible focal relation. Full-resolution review caught and repaired the returning request ribbon on the left action-safe boundary; its complete wording now remains visible through the final payoff and handoff.

motion_quality.rationale: Assumptions hitch onto the request, route choices fork, semantic rails separate, fields fan through a prism, defaults branch inside a reversible enclosure, corrections update the checksum, gates pass or stop plans, material deltas reopen intake, policy narrows, stale identities fail, and the closing review role crosses into the next boundary.

synchronization.rationale: Twenty-seven audio-derived beats, 70 exact-receipt caption cues, and the delivery master agree within one 30-fps frame across a 281.345-second plan. Full-resolution review also replaced a 6.03-second scorecard hold with nine ordered highlights that now follow the spoken metric enumeration through privacy and useful completion.

continuity.rationale: The raw request, desired-outcome rail, authority rail, intent receipt, versioned contract, and authority gate retain stable semantics. V1 remains visible when V2 is derived, and the unchanged opening request returns inside the safe frame for the private-draft-now versus explicit-publication-later resolution.

pacing.rationale: The 621-word narration plays at about 133 words per minute. The viewer gets an early prediction, fast field construction, distinct checksum and re-contract turns, consequence-scaled governance, a synchronized nine-measure scorecard, a deliberate evidence ceiling, and a concise callback without any detected six-second freeze.

voice.rationale: The narration is concrete, conversational, and restrained. It repeatedly distinguishes wanting an outcome from granting authority, turns qualifications into visible mechanisms, and avoids treating inference, schema conformance, or a fluent request as consent, ownership, deployment authority, or satisfaction.

sound_mix.rationale: The pinned narration-only mix decodes at 48 kilohertz mono and measures minus 16.4 LUFS integrated, 3.1 LU range, and minus 1.4 dBTP, with no detected three-second silence. Physical-device audition remains a release-candidate obligation.

engagement.rationale: The publish-today hook creates immediate consequence; five ungranted powers visibly hitch a ride; the viewer predicts among act, refuse, and ask-all; the relabeling attack fails; V2 earns one narrow channel; and the opening object returns to resolve useful help against ambient power.

accessibility.rationale: Every route, default, permission, stop, correction, lifecycle state, evidence limit, and handoff duplicates color with text, position, enclosure, line style, shape, or endpoint. The descriptive transcript covers all material visual changes, 70 caption cues pass representative review, and essential objects remain interpretable above the caption region.

claim_fidelity.rationale: The finite checksum, separate affected-party gates, policy-narrowing rule, current-authority test, nine-dimensional proposed scorecard, argument-support boundary, and five explicit nonclaims prevent accidental promotion to language understanding, valid consent, satisfaction, deployment, effect safety, transfer, state of the art, AGI, or ASI.

non_claim: Two rejected full-resolution candidates remain part of the local generation history: the first exposed a clipped callback at the left action-safe edge, and the second exposed a 6.03-second scorecard hold after that edge repair. Passing the corrected lock records final geometry, narration, captions, transcript, thumbnail, timing, and experience review only; release-candidate, independent review, publication, and book-evidence promotion remain ungranted.
